analysis: Revenue was $3K in FY 2022, down 60% year over year.

Gross margin was 100.0%, unchanged from FY 2021. Operating costs exceeded revenue by $213K, an operating margin of -6568.5%. Operating expenses grew 215% against revenue growth of -60%. The year ended with a net loss of $209K.
Operating cash flow was −$785K. Working capital and other items used $576K.
